# discord_soundboard_sounds (Data Source)

Lists the soundboard sounds of a server. Discord's default sounds are listed by `discord_default_soundboard_sounds`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_soundboard_sounds" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `sounds` (Attributes List) The sounds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sounds))

<a id="nestedatt--sounds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sounds`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the sound can be used; false when the server lost the boosts it needs.
- `emoji_id` (String) ID of the sound's custom emoji.
- `emoji_name` (String) Unicode character of the sound's standard emoji.
- `id` (String) Sound ID.
- `name` (String) Sound name.
- `volume` (Number) Volume, from 0 to 1.
